title: Suspense with use()
summary: Read a promise with `use` and let a Suspense boundary show the fallback.
prompt: Finish `UserName` and `Profile`. `UserName` reads `userPromise` with `use()` and renders the name in a heading. `Profile` wraps it in `<Suspense>` with the fallback "Loading profile…". The promise is created outside the component and passed in.
hints: `const user = use(userPromise)` suspends until the promise settles. It can be called conditionally, unlike other hooks.
Never create the promise during render: each render would make a new one and suspend again.
